turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello! How have you been lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm buying gear for my podcast and I can't decide what to get.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to describe all the options before I hear your opinion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option one is a USB microphone for about a hundred dollars that plugs right into my laptop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option two is a proper mixer and two XLR microphones, which costs around four hundred.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a portable recorder with built-in mics, good for recording on the go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all the options. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The portable recorder is great if you plan to interview people out in the world. For a studio-style show with a co-host, though, the two XLR microphones will sound noticeably better.
